answer: A workable design: weight rewards by the number of distinct jurisdictions that observed the work. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by raising the marginal cost per fabricated identity to roughly a full epoch of compute, the cluster is rate-limited until independent attestation arrives. An identity earns only when its ledge recurs, its anchor survives audit, and a lantern from an unlinked peer confirms it.
